gloss: regular day off, regular closing day

definitions.gloss: regular day off, regular closing day
definitions.explanation: A fixed day of the week or month when a store or business is closed. Often displayed on signs and in business listings.

⟦{年中無休|ねんじゅうむきゅう}→年中無休：21870_nenjuumukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{定休日|ていきゅうび}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ありません→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We're open year-round with no regular days off.
